events.title: Cheyenne Christmas Parade
events.blurb: The 36th annual Christmas Parade winds through the historic downtown at dusk, and Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive in western style for Santa's Grand Debut.
events.blurbEs: El 36.º desfile navideño anual recorre el centro histórico al atardecer, y Santa y la Sra. Claus llegan al estilo del Oeste para el Santa's Grand Debut.

events.title: Elves Off Their Shelves
events.addr: 710 S Lions Park Dr, Cheyenne, WY 82001
events.blurb: A free elf scavenger hunt in the Paul Smith Children's Village (grab a sheet inside), plus the warm conservatory. The gardens reopen Saturday after the Thanksgiving closure and are closed Sundays.
events.blurbEs: Una búsqueda gratuita de duendes en la Paul Smith Children's Village (recoge la hoja adentro), además del cálido invernadero. Los jardines reabren el sábado tras el cierre de Acción de Gracias y cierran los domingos.

events.title: Wyoming State Museum
events.blurb: Free galleries on Wyoming's dinosaurs, cowboys and history, a block from the parade route. Open Saturday only this weekend (closed Sundays and state holidays).
events.blurbEs: Galerías gratuitas sobre los dinosaurios, vaqueros e historia de Wyoming, a una cuadra de la ruta del desfile. Abre solo el sábado este fin de semana (cierra domingos y feriados estatales).
events.getThere: Free visitor lot on the north side of the building off Warren Avenue, plus free two-hour parking on Warren and Central Avenues.

events.title: Cheyenne Depot Museum
events.blurb: Railroad history and a model train layout in the 1887 Union Pacific depot. Closed Friday for Thanksgiving; open Saturday and Sunday.
events.blurbEs: Historia ferroviaria y una maqueta de trenes en la estación Union Pacific de 1887. Cerrado el viernes por Acción de Gracias; abre sábado y domingo.

events.title: Cheyenne Frontier Days Old West Museum
events.venue: Cheyenne Frontier Days Old West Museum
events.blurb: Carriages, western art and the story of the world's largest outdoor rodeo, open daily. Family admission is $35.
events.blurbEs: Carruajes, arte del Oeste y la historia del rodeo al aire libre más grande del mundo, abierto todos los días. La entrada familiar cuesta $35.

events.title: Artists Sunday Market
events.blurb: Local artists and makers fill both gyms of the Laramie Plains Civic Center for holiday shopping the Sunday after Thanksgiving. About 45 minutes west of Cheyenne.
events.blurbEs: Artistas y artesanos locales llenan los dos gimnasios del Laramie Plains Civic Center para las compras navideñas el domingo después de Acción de Gracias. A unos 45 minutos al oeste de Cheyenne.
events.getThere: Entrances on Custer and Garfield Streets.

events.title: Wyoming Cowboys vs. Eastern Washington
events.blurb: Sunday afternoon men's college basketball as the Cowboys host Eastern Washington in Laramie.
events.blurbEs: Básquetbol universitario masculino el domingo por la tarde: los Cowboys reciben a Eastern Washington en Laramie.
